en: This postcard displays a black-and-white photograph of a landscaped park with well-kept paths, manicured bushes, a reflective ornamental pond, and a bandstand or pavilion in the background. The upper left contains red printed text reading 'Bad Pyrmont Partie vor dem Kurhaus.' The back of the card features an insignia for 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT' and standard postcard layout.
